question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this six-query provider-neutral Gitcrawl evidence contract as the permanent foundation for the open deployment, receipt, and cloud-intake stack?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and no concrete defect was found, but establishing a large cross-repository contract and ownership boundary requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the bounded foundation
options.body: Confirm the contract with crawl-remote and review the stacked consumers against this exact head before landing the foundation first.

options.title: Keep the stack in draft
options.body: Leave this PR and its dependents unmerged until the hosted query contract or ownership boundary is narrowed or revised.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded foundation
recommendation.body: Confirm the contract with crawl-remote and review the stacked consumers against this exact head before landing the foundation first.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the coordinated Gitcrawl stack and can present its cross-repository contract and validation evidence.
